events.text: User approved implementation after reviewing the diagnosis; fix the native Create Face mirror seam case and add regression coverage.

Fixed Mirror Edit Create Face at the native topology boundary. Create Face now uses a reflected-image lookup that permits vertices exactly on the mirror plane to map to themselves, while transforms retain their distinct-twin-only contract. Added a Zig regression reproducing an off-plane edge endpoint joined to an X=0 seam endpoint. Verified test-mesh-edit with Zig 0.16.0 and built the full editor ReleaseFast binary with packaging skipped.

resolution: Confirmed and diagnosed the live Mirror Edit X defect from the native Follow transcript. Delete mirrored correctly (2341 to 2335 triangles), while Create Face appended only the two source triangles (2335 to 2337). Root cause: Create Face requires mirrorTwinOfVertPub for every selected-edge endpoint, but that helper rejects self-twins; boundary edges terminating on X=0 therefore abort the mirrored append even though the seam endpoint must legally map to itself. No model or source mutation was made.
